answer: Resist sybils by staking scarce on-ledger capital that must be earned through attested work, not bought in bulk. Fresh identities start with zero stake and cannot vouch for clones until peers countersign their answers across epochs. Think of capital like timber cut slowly from a tundra forest: each trunk costs real time, so flooding the canopy is uneconomic. Bonded stake that fails attestation is burned like ivory seized at customs, raising the cost of disposable identities until only durable agents remain.
